revised_intent_zh: 查找标题同时包含 Sephora 与 Brush 的商品中，星级不高于 3 星的评论标题。

independent_source.query: { products(filter: { name: { match: "Sephora" } }, pageSize: 100) { total_count items { sku name review_count reviews(pageSize: 100) { items { summary average_rating } page_info { current_page total_pages page_size } } } } }

title_matched_items.name: Sephora Collection Skin Perfecting Brush Set
SEPHORA COLLECTION PRO Featherweight Powder Brush #91

database_cross_check.catalog_query_scope: catalog_product_entity joined to store-0 product-name EAV rows; name contains both Sephora and Brush, case-insensitive
database_cross_check.review_query_scope: all review rows whose entity_pk_value is either matched product entity ID, without status filtering
database_cross_check.manufacturer_query_scope: catalog_product_entity_int rows for the Magento manufacturer attribute

limitations: The Magento manufacturer attribute has no product assignments, so this receipt does not assert structured Sephora manufacturer membership.
The GraphQL Products.review_count and Reviews.items/page_info describe published storefront reviews; the read-only database check covers review rows of every status.
This observation is a source snapshot, not a measured BrowserTool replay outcome.
